stories.title: Convert supported JSON to YAML faithfully
stories.description: As a developer, I want to convert JSON to YAML without silent data loss, so that I can change notation while retaining meaning.

requirements.text: When supported JSON is converted to YAML, the converter shall preserve its JSON values and structure.
If JSON contains duplicate object keys, then the converter shall reject the conversion as ambiguous.

scenarios.name: Convert an ordinary JSON document
scenarios.given: the JSON contains strings, finite supported numbers, booleans, null and arrays
scenarios.when: the developer converts it to YAML
scenarios.then: parsing the result under the documented schema yields equivalent values and structure
scenarios.verification: Golden scalar/array/object cases; quote ambiguous strings; precision-aware comparisons

scenarios.name: Reject duplicate-key conversion
scenarios.then: an ambiguity diagnostic appears without a lossy output
scenarios.verification: Duplicate keys, unsupported numeric precision and output expansion tests; no JS-number round trip

stories.title: Convert supported YAML to strict JSON
stories.description: As a developer, I want to convert a safe YAML subset to JSON, so that I can use configuration values in JSON tools.

requirements.text: When a supported single YAML document is converted, the converter shall produce strict JSON with equivalent supported values.
If YAML requests custom tags or exceeds the alias-expansion budget, then the converter shall reject it.

scenarios.name: Convert a safe mapping
scenarios.given: the YAML is a single document with unique string keys and supported scalar values
scenarios.when: the developer converts it to JSON
scenarios.then: the output is strict JSON representing those values
scenarios.verification: Schema-specific mapping/list fixtures and quoted date-like strings

scenarios.name: Reject resource-expanding YAML
scenarios.given: the input contains aliases exceeding the configured expansion budget
scenarios.then: the worker rejects the input without freezing the workspace
scenarios.verification: Aliases, custom tags, multiple documents, duplicate/non-string keys, non-finite and unsafe numbers
